data.description: 【伊冯 · 街机厅】终末地补给站的街机厅里，伊冯把摇杆搓出火星，连赢三局的战绩让她得意地翘起尾巴，霓虹光把粉色双马尾染成七彩——「格斗游戏？本天才的业余爱好罢了～」
data.promptProse: Yvonne stands at the supply-station arcade cabinet, working the joystick with one hand and the buttons with the other, her tail lifted proudly after another win. Keep her cream-and-coral cardigan, navy T-shirt, charcoal midi skirt, opaque tights, painted nails and pink twin tails in the medium view. The control panel projects toward the lower edge; cabinet sides overlap behind her in a receding row, ending in the darker arcade aisle. Multicolored neon catches the outside of her hair, while the game screen lights her face and moving fingertips. Her hand interrupts the screen reflection on the panel, and the joystick base casts a short shadow that makes its contact with the controls clear.
data.title: 伊冯 · 街机厅
